verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a built-in "fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases" and a plan agent for analyzing code without changes, which lets the agent explore a repo itself rather than having files hand-picked. Automatic LSP loading also gives the model code intelligence, and community users praise the LSP integration and subagents. missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-repo mapping or architecture-explanation output, detail on what the project init command analyzes, independent hands-on reports of explaining an unfamiliar codebase end-to-end.
